title: Normalized strict completion-to-compactification comparison word
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integer ring $O$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the actual pulled-back completed integral coefficient sheaves $R_T$ and the constant quotient sheaves $A_{n,T}=(O/\ell^{n+1})_T$ on the small pro-etale site, with their actual quotient transitions [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers] [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Let $D_T$ be the recorded exact strict coefficient-system presentation and $r_T$ its recorded derived tensor reduction [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized]. Use exact scalar forgetting $U_T$ into strict fixed-$R_T$ towers and $L_T=\mathcal L_TU_T$, where $\mathcal L_T$ is the actual total derived inverse limit with its canonical projections [det-sp-normalized-equivalence] [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. A normalized reduction/limit presentation consists of exactness of $U_T$, an adjunction $r_T\dashv L_T$, its finite derived scalar identifications, their compatibility with the universal reduction counit on every complex and with scalar-first local tensor generators, and the equation identifying each projection of its unit with the actual scalar adjunction unit. A normalized evaluation identifies the two existing ordinary strict-system evaluations by the identity on sections. All these conditions are data predicates; no existence is asserted here. Use the simultaneous ordinary section-model open extension and direct image, transported through their recorded exact equivalences, and then separately localize open extension and right derive direct image [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], put $P_c=Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ on ordinary unbounded module derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Use the completed coefficient pullback identifications, the finite constant coefficient identifications, and the canonical scalar restriction comparisons normalized on extension summands and direct-image composition units [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Define $\lambda_j:j_{!,R}\mathcal L_X\to\mathcal L_{\bar X}j_{!,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ to be the mate of the identity constant-tower/open square, and define $a_p:Rp_{*,R}\mathcal L_{\bar X}\simeq\mathcal L_YRp_{*,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ by conjugating the identity constant-tower/inverse-image square through the geometric and limit adjunctions [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-strict-tower-realization]. Given the canonical ordinary strict open scalar isomorphism $e_0$ and a derived strict direct-image scalar isomorphism $d$, localize $e_0$ to $e$, and put $b=d\circ Rp_{*,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}(e)$. Define the natural transformation on the whole unbounded source category by the specified ordered word
$$P_c\xrightarrow{P_c(\eta)}P_cL_Xr_X\xrightarrow{Rp_{*,R}(\lambda_j)}Rp_{*,R}\mathcal L_{\bar X}j_{!,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}U_Xr_X\xrightarrow{a_p}\mathcal L_YRp_{*,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}j_{!,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}U_Xr_X\xrightarrow{\mathcal L_Y(b)}L_YRp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}r_X.$$
The unit used in this word is exactly the one in the normalized presentation, and derived completeness refers to invertibility of this specified unit [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. This definition asserts neither invertibility of the word nor existence of the normalized presentation or scalar comparison data.
